title: Final Eccentricity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the eccentricity epsilon' equals 1 for a parabolic orbit.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the calculation of the total energy before and after the change in k, showing that E' equals 0.

title: Potential Energy Change
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain how the potential energy is affected by the change in k, specifically that U' equals U/2.

title: Kinetic Energy Consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student should clarify that the kinetic energy remains unchanged immediately after k is halved.

title: Eccentricity Formula Reference
description: Optional Criteria: The student may reference the eccentricity formula and how it applies to the situation, even if not crucial for the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid errors related to miscalculating the relationship between kinetic and potential energy or misunderstanding the implications of the eccentricity value.
